newsitem.title: PERU: Peru bolsa head sees mkt up mimimum 25 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Peru bolsa head sees mkt up mimimum 25 pct in 1997.

text.p: The President of the Lima Stock Exchange, Jose Luque, said Wednesday the bolsa will register an average profit of at least 25 percent this year.
"The profitability could be around 25 to 30 percent, an average which is quite good," Luque told a local radio station.
During the first half, the bolsa's general index .IGRA rose 53.01 percent and the blue-chip selective index .ISEL increased 56.76 percent.
Luque said those gains were due to an exceptional surge in the mining sector that might not continue into the second half.

"The rise in share prices between January and June was supported by the interest in minerals shares because of the good price of metals in the international market," Luque said, adding that copper and zinc prices had particularly benefited the bolsa.
"This marked factor pulled up the shares of other companies that were cheap."
Mining labor shares were the highest-performing sector in the first half, up 178.56 percent.
